stem.text: The diagram shows a particle P, travelling at speed $v$, about to collide with a stationary particle Q of the same mass. The collision is perfectly elastic.

stem.alt: Two circles side by side labelled P (left) and Q (right), with an arrow above P labelled v pointing to the right.

stem.text: Which statement describes the motion of P and of Q immediately after the collision?

A.text: P and Q both travel in the same direction with speed $\dfrac{1}{2}v$.

B.text: P comes to rest and Q acquires speed $v$.

C.text: P rebounds with speed $\dfrac{1}{2}v$ and Q acquires speed $\dfrac{1}{2}v$.

D.text: P rebounds with speed $v$ and Q remains stationary.
